note.title: Free-time activities
note.specFocus: Hobbies, sport, music, cinema, television, reading, gaming, eating out, shopping, online leisure, and plans for leisure time.
note.sourcePages: Original GCSE Spanish revision material; it is not an official AQA paper, mark scheme, or copied publisher content.
note.summary:
Free-time activities

Key vocabulary
- el tiempo libre; practicar; tocar un instrumento; escuchar; ver; leer; salir; el videojuego; la entrada; la cartelera; quedar con; relajarse; disfrutar de; aficionarse a

Key grammar
- Use gustar/encantar/interesar and change the form for plural activities. Use hace + time expressions for how long, the preterite for a recent event, and near future/future for plans.

Exam tips
- Use ir al cine rather than ir a el cine. Distinguish ver (to watch) from mirar (to look at), and use tocar for playing an instrument.

questions.examTip: Build a short description, an opinion with porque and a personal or hypothetical comment.
questions.modelAnswer:
En la foto se ven jóvenes que tocan instrumentos en una plaza. Las personas parecen concentradas y de buen humor. A mi parecer, esta situación es positiva porque muestra algo importante sobre lo que haces en tu tiempo libre. Además, me gustaría participar porque sería una experiencia útil y memorable.

(English: In the photo I can see young people playing instruments in a square. The people seem focused and in good spirits. In my opinion, this situation is positive because it shows something important about the topic. I would also like to take part because it would be useful and memorable.)
questions.question: Describe this photo showing young people playing instruments in a square. Explain what the people are doing, make two reasonable inferences and give your own justified opinion about the topic.

questions.examTip: Cover all bullets and keep speaking; an opinion plus reason is better than a long but unfinished sentence.
questions.modelAnswer:
— Los sábados toco la guitarra con un grupo de amigos. A mi modo de ver es importante porque tiene ventajas para mí y para otras personas. — (Unexpected question) Este domingo vamos a visitar un museo moderno.

(English: — On Saturdays I play the guitar with a group of friends. In my view it is important because it has benefits for me and other people. — This Sunday we are going to visit a modern museum.)
questions.question: Role-play: your teacher plays a Spanish friend. Talk about lo que haces en tu tiempo libre. You must: (1) say what you normally do or prefer, (2) explain your opinion and a reason, and (3) respond to the unexpected question: “What happened recently?”
